notes: Inter-municipal community CIMAA (Alto Alentejo, HQ Portalegre) creating a regional shared-services data centre ('Centro de Dados Informatico') for 11 member municipalities; ~EUR 3M invested; supports computing/communications infrastructure and smart-territory projects.
